findings.summary: Actual native original PersonnelWorkspace calls missing personnel list/context/commit/confirm RPCs after its real business authority check. No fallback exists.

Base ClientLegalDocumentsScreen focus=contracts imports extensionless ClientFinancingWorkspace. Android selects the generated .native implementation over the base null placeholder; authorized context read requires absent financing RPCs. Old private-Web/native-empty comment is inaccurate for actual Metro selection.

Normalized context tabs discarded requested legacy detail tabs; actual screen silently displayed overview. Billing now opens its actual existing billing profile/contracts only with exact financial-view permission. Other unsupported targets clearly remain unavailable; current edited budget survives invalid URL targets. No clinical module enabled.

Tab hook previously ignored an unchanged requested target after the available tab set changed asynchronously. Incoming tab-set identity now participates in re-evaluation; dirty/busy/identity guards remain tested.

Old assertions expected a removed live-activation block, obsolete status mapper, previous Office receiver/alias architecture and implementation-local styles. Current assertions preserve exact version-bound server receipt checks, immutable originals, closed status mapping, shared surface re-export and explicit native saved-area targets. Existing actual completion/status/original/lifecycle tests pass separately; source checks alone do not establish product safety.
Broad one-worker run hit 5-second timeouts in retry/conflict cases. Entire unchanged actual native Notes interaction suite rerun alone: 10/10 passed in 16.86s. No product or timeout changes made.

Client record/full-detail hooks lacked dataset query keys, retaining previous actor/tenant/record or sensitivity data while new reads completed. Both hooks now bind async data and late completions to actor, tenant, record, role and read/sensitivity rights, disable reads on revoked view access and synchronously clear prior data. Record service now forwards sensitivity permission instead of using a default unmasked full-detail read. Server RLS remains authoritative.
